entries.text: Ow! Damn! A bee just stung me, eh? Well, now, don't you all take the cake? Does your mom ever mix you up?
entries.speaker: Repairman

entries.text: I've come to you at great risk. I mean you no harm.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: How do I know you're for real?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: First I want you to come somewhere with me. I want you to come with me to see my mother.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Stay out of his way. He doesn't want to hurt you. You can't use your gun!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Scully, get the car! This way.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Hey! Jeremiah! Jeremiah, stop! What are you doing?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: There'll be more right behind him.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: I need your help! My mother is dying!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: They'll know where to find us. They'll be waiting for us.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: Your government men. They'll be waiting at the hospital with your mother.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: What can they do? We're working in the light. They can't stop us without exposure, without consequence.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You have to understand something. I must perish. Whatever the consequences to that end, they are incalculable to the preservation of the larger plan.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: The larger plan? You mean colonization?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Hegemony, mr. Mulder. A new origin of species.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: My mother is dying. I need to take you to see her right now.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: And if they are waiting for us, if they're willing to kill me... And face the consequences of their actions, to stand before your ineffectual justice system, I will be dead. I won't be able to save your mother. The work will go on. The plan will continue to be executed. Or you can stop it.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: I can take you to a place, show you the work in progress where you can see--
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: Where you can see your sister.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: Certainly he anticipated we'd be here waiting.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Unless we had a security leak.
entries.speaker: Elder

entries.text: I've come in receipt of some pictures... Of your visit to mrs. Mulder's summerhouse. Were you aware you were being photographed?
entries.speaker: Elder

entries.text: I believe that can be determined by a simple planting of information... To see where that information flows.
entries.speaker: Elder

entries.text: That mrs. Mulder's life is in danger. That, left unprotected, she may come to an unnatural end.
entries.speaker: Elder

entries.text: Scully, it's me. Where are you?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I'm right where you left me. I'm sitting here in my car.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Because you wouldn't answer your phone, and I didn't know what else to do.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Listen. There's going to be people looking for me. They're going to think they can get to me through you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Hold on. Just listen for a second. I need you to do something for me. I had to steal a car from an airport in alberta. There's going to be a record of me going through canadian customs. I need you to cover my tracks. I also need you to know I'm okay. I'm fine, okay?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The man you left for dead. He's alive.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: About 20 Miles. Maybe half that on foot over those hills.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: I heard you were looking for me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: There's been some concern about you and agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: We're fine, sir. We've been searching for this man, Jeremiah Smith.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I received a memo from you that there's more confusion about this man. That the social security administration has five men with this name... Working in branch offices around the country... With identical photo ID's. We ran a check on these men. All five have not reported to work in three days. Would you or agent Mulder like to let me in on what it is your suspicions are?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I'm afraid we haven't exactly formulated any clear suspicions, sir.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We were able to download the hard drive data... From each of the five missing men's social security workstations. In each case, we found an enormous amount of files and data that cannot be identified, do not correspond with any kind of accounting or document collection... Done as normal departmental business. The data was all locked in password files.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: How much of it is there?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Enough to fill seven ten-gigabyte hard drives. Roughly a billion entries.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: It appears to be some kind of personal record keeping or accounting.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Could it be some kind of cryptogram?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: If it is, I can't crack it.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'd like to get a copy of a portion of this. I might be able to figure it out.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Maybe. There's somebody I want to run it by.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: No. I think, sir, this is more along my field of expertise.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: SCI-CRIME LAB ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I wouldn't touch the body, mr. Mulder.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: There's a work order here. It's for yesterday. He's only been here a little more than 24 hours. You know what killed him, don't you?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It's not much further. You're looking at the future, mr. Mulder.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: A flowering shrub. But its specific epithet can't be found on any of your taxonomic charts.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: What is this? What's going on here?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That looks just like my sister. But that's not possible. She's no older than the day she was taken. Samantha? Samantha? Samantha? Samantha? Samantha? Samantha, it's me. It's me, Fox, your brother. Do you remember me? What's wrong with her?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: She's a drone, mr. Mulder, a worker.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: There's more you should see so that you might understand.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: They're stationed here. They're part of an agrarian workforce.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: They take care of themselves. Parenting is unnecessary, a needless division of energy.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: Serial ovotypes. Have you seen enough? We can't stay around here much longer. I'll go see if I can find some gas.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: How did you know I was here?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I've been trying to reach agent Mulder. I watched you enter the building. Where is he?
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: I have information for him, a matter that would concern him greatly.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: I prefer to speak with agent Mulder directly. Let me just say she is unprotected.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: If you want to involve yourself, agent Scully, you might do well to give this information to your partner.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Not until you give me some information first. These are data entries taken from social security records.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You're going in the wrong direction.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: All beginning with the letters "s.e.p." you know what these are. Confirm or deny.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Don't unlock doors you're not prepared to go through.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: Leave it alone. Protect the mother.
entries.speaker: X

entries.text: You can't do this. She's not your sister.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: You have a chance here to understand something so much greater, to comprehend it, to expose it.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: Then explain it to me. Explain it to me now!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Are bees what killed that man we found?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: It's probably not a good idea to hide in there.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You have no immunity to them.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: But you do? Somebody lead me. I can't see anything. Is that the only way out?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I think we've walked into our own trap.
entries.speaker: Jeremiah Smith

entries.text: Good, because I think I've made some headway on this data. Can you call up the files?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah. I've got to tell you I've gotten nowhere.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: I got lucky, but the key is in this first string of letters.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You say a 20-letter code to any scientist, and they immediately think... Protein amino acid sequence code, which is what this turned out to be.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: The cowpox virus, the virus used to inoculate humans against smallpox.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Okay, right. So these guys were keeping records of smallpox inoculations. Why?
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: I haven't worked that out yet. But the big question is this second alphanumeric string-- 15 digits.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Yeah. I checked. Each one is different. An infinite number of variations.
entries.speaker: Agent Pendrell

entries.text: With all due respect, agent Scully, it looks like something from the hubble telescope.
entries.speaker: Second Senior Agent
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Actually, it's an image created by what's called a confocal microscope. You're looking at a three-dimensional picture of the location of a protein. In this case, cowpox structural protein number six. It's one of the inoculants used in the smallpox vaccine.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Senior FBI Agent
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: From me. I had a biopsy taken from the smallpox vaccination scar on my upper arm. Through a process called immunohistochemical staining... And through the addition of an antibody for the cowpox virus six, I was able to get this picture of the location of a protein-- a single, nonrandom protein pattern.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'm not a scientist, and I don't know that many people in this room--
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: What I'm saying is that I think this protein is a tag, some kind of genetic marker that was applied to me... When I was inoculated against smallpox as a child.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Senior FBI Agent
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Not just me, all of us, quite possibly anybody who's been inoculated over the past 50 years.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Agent Scully, frankly this sounds like... Something we might have expected from agent Mulder.
entries.speaker: Second Senior Agent
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I had my doubts, and I'm still not certain. But I performed the same procedure on agent Pendrell. The location of the protein from his biopsy should be identical to mine, but it's slightly different, which might correspond to the alphanumeric entries... Collected by the men at the, uh, social security administration.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: So what you're saying is we're being cataloged, tagged and inventoried? By who?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I don't know. But it would have to be a government agency.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Senior FBI Agent
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I don't know that either. I think the only man who might be able to give us that information is Jeremiah Smith.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Agent Scully, can I see you outside for a moment? Alone. Do you realize what you're promoting in there? You're rounding these people up in the middle of a workday to imply that there's some--
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I am a scientist, sir. What I'm promoting in there is reductive evidence. It's the reason I was assigned to the x files in the first place, is it not? To put agent Mulder's work to the test of science?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ phone beeps ] Scully. Where are you right now?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'm in Skinner's office. Where are you?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'm still in canada, but I'm catching a plane soon. I need you to meet me on the other end.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: At the hospital where my mother is.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Her life depends upon me and my party getting there safely.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Jeremiah Smith and someone else. I'm gonna need some protection.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Believe me, you're going to have it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: There's a lot of people who want to talk to Jeremiah Smith.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: [ groans ] please. You can't kill him. He can't die.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Alien Bounty Hunter
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: He shows you pieces, but tells you nothing of the whole, because he's inconsequential, a traitor to the project.
entries.speaker: Alien Bounty Hunter
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: You'd trade your life for his?
entries.speaker: Alien Bounty Hunter
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Alien Bounty Hunter
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR WALTER SKINNER'S OFFICE ·  FBI HEADQUARTERS ·  WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: He's in touch with the perimeter. I'm sorry, sir. For security reasons--
entries.speaker: Security Officer

entries.text: Five hours we're out here swinging in the wind, agent Scully.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You don't have any way of getting a hold of him?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: This is beginning to seriously compromise our ability to treat patients.
entries.speaker: Nurse

entries.text: Just a moment, sir. Oh, my god! Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Mulder, you're fr-- no. You're freezing. He's in shock-- you're in shock, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: She'll never know. [ whispers ] she'll never know.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We could have saved her, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: As long as she's lying here, you can't give up on her. I don't care what the doctors say.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I had one chance, and I let it slip away.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You don't know that. You can't blame yourself for what you could only hope.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: He took me to a place with green fields, and I saw my sister. She was just a little girl. I've seen too many things not to believe.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I've seen things, too, but there are answers to be found now. We have hope that there's a place to start. That's what I believe.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You put such faith in your science, Scully, but... The things I've seen, science provides no place to start.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Nothing happens in contradiction to nature, only in contradiction to what we know of it. And that's a place to start. That's where the hope is.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I feel I came so close.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I feel it too. I know it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I was warned... By a man we both know, who I believe knows the truth, who can lead us to a place to start.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Mr. Mulder? My name is marita Covarrubias. I am the assistant to the special representative.
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.text: Was he able to review the material I sent him?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.text: I'm afraid he's been called into something important. Can I ask who sent you here, mr. Mulder?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.text: A friend. I've been inquiring with each of the special representatives... All month about the farmland in canada. I've been trying to get some reasons, and all I've gotten are dead ends.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.text: I can tell you that farm has been abandoned. The crops you described were left to die. But they have been identified as ginseng. No evidence of beehives or bee husbandry was found. I know it's not the answer you wanted. No. I, uh-- can I ask why this is so important to you?
entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.text: I have suffered-- I've suffered some very personal losses recently and-- I was-- I was hoping... That, um--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.speaker: Marita Covarrubias
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.speaker: Sound
entries.location: UNITED NATIONS BUILDING ·  NEW YORK CITY ·  ONE MONTH LATER

entries.text: I need to know the reasons why this should be.
entries.speaker: Alien Bounty Hunter

entries.text: So that the work may continue, so that the project may proceed unabated... By removing an unnecessary obstacle.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Agent Mulder, actually. If his mother were to die, he would--
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You see, the fiercest enemy is the man who has nothing left to lose. And you know how important agent Mulder is to the equation.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
